name: TeamSpec
description:
TeamSpec is the user-provided configuration of a team.

 A team's name and handle live in its metadata (name, slug); the spec
 carries only what describes the team to the people choosing it. Who is in
 the team is not part of the spec: membership is granted and revoked as
 access, one person at a time, so it is visible and audited the way every
 other grant is.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: What the team is for, shown where people pick a team to share with.
